'''2000 Nashville Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 19–20 August 2000<ref name="gs00cal" />
* '''Site:''' Nashville, Tennessee; Super 8 Motel, Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="tr-d1223" />
* '''Players:''' 32<ref name="tr-d1223" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Praskac]]<ref name="tr-d1227" />

== Decklists ==
* [[2000 Decipher World Championship Steven Lewis Invincible Court]] — [[Steven Lewis]] says he used this deck at the Nashville Grand Slam, Worlds Day 1 and the DecipherCon team tournament, and that it was never defeated in tournament play.<ref name="dt-11223">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11223 Invincible Court], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 17 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11223/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11223/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018103920/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11223/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
* [[2000 Nashville Grand Slam Clint Hays Got Evader]] ([[Clint Hays]], [[Light]]) — "a metagame choice for me at the nashville grand slam".
* [[2000 Nashville Grand Slam Charlie Herren Moe Larry Curly and 25 of their closest friends (Profit)]] ([[Charlie Herren]], [[Light]]) — "the deck that I used at the Nashville GS".

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub (Decipher's Grand Slam calendar) dates this event 19–20 August 2000, but Jonathan Chu's report says the Slam was postponed until 9 September 2000, and Chris Praskac's report dates the tournament day 9/9/2000; the six DeckTech reports on it were posted 13–14 September 2000. The deck pages linked from the hub repeat the August date.<ref name="tr-d1223" />
